ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.TITLE: Usage & billing
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.DESCRIPTION: Track your conversation allowance and manage your subscription.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.COUNTING: A conversation counts once in each 24-hour window. Messages within that window do not add to your usage.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.MANAGED_PLAN: Your subscription is managed by your account team.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.PAID_WARNING: You are close to your monthly conversation allowance. AI and agent replies continue as usual.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.TRIAL_WARNING: Your trial is close to its conversation limit. AI replies pause for new conversations when the limit is reached.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.PAUSED: Trial AI replies are paused because the trial ended or its conversation limit was reached. You can still receive messages and reply as an agent.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.PAUSED_NOTICE: Trial AI replies are paused. Agent replies remain available.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.SETUP_FEE: Plus a one-time setup fee of {amount}.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.NOT_CONFIGURED_HELP: Contact your account administrator to set up billing and conversation limits.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.LOAD_ERROR: We could not refresh your usage. Please try again.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.PAYMENT_ERROR: We could not open the payment page. Please try again.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.LIMIT_NEAR_NOTICE: You are approaching your monthly conversation allowance.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.PAID_LIMIT_REACHED: You have used your monthly conversation allowance. AI and agent replies continue as usual.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.FOUNDER_HELP: Special pricing for our early clients, with access to the features included in your account.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.CANCELING_HELP: Your subscription is scheduled to end. Automatic renewal is off. Manage your subscription to review or change the cancellation.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.INVOICE_TOTAL_HELP: This is the recurring price before invoice adjustments. Invoices show the final total, including any taxes, discounts or credits.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.CHECKOUT_HELP: Review the payment amount and any remaining trial in secure checkout before subscribing.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.PORTAL_HELP: Review payments, download invoices and manage the subscription securely. Contact your account team to change your billing frequency.
ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTION.SYNC_ERROR: We could not verify your subscription with the payment provider. Saved details may be out of date. Refresh before starting a new subscription.

STATUS_HELP.active: Your subscription is active. Payments and invoices are available below.
STATUS_HELP.trialing: Your account is in a trial. Review its end date and any scheduled payment below.
STATUS_HELP.trial_ended: Your trial has ended. Subscribe below or contact your account team.
STATUS_HELP.past_due: A subscription payment is overdue. Review your invoices and payment method to resolve it.
STATUS_HELP.unpaid: Your subscription has unpaid invoices. Review the balance and contact your account team if you need help.
STATUS_HELP.incomplete: Your subscription was created, but the first payment has not completed. Review payment below instead of starting another subscription.
STATUS_HELP.incomplete_expired: The first subscription payment was not completed before checkout expired. You can start a new subscription below.
STATUS_HELP.canceled: This subscription has ended and will not renew. You can subscribe again below if billing is available.
STATUS_HELP.paused: Your subscription is paused. Review it below or contact your account team to resume.
STATUS_HELP.manual: No online subscription is linked to this account. If your account team bills you separately, confirm with them before subscribing.
STATUS_HELP.unknown: We could not determine the subscription status. Review it with your account team before making a payment.
STATUS_HELP.renewal_deferred: Your account team has deferred the next subscription payment. Review the new payment date below.

DATA_EXPORTS.TITLE: Data exports
DATA_EXPORTS.DESCRIPTION: Get a ZIP with spreadsheets you can open in Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers, readable conversation transcripts and original files. Downloads are available for 7 days.
DATA_EXPORTS.EXCLUSIONS: Shopify product catalog, credentials, assistant instructions and internal strategy are excluded.
DATA_EXPORTS.PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Download a copy of your contacts, conversations and knowledge. Choose what to include, track preparation and download it when it’s ready.
DATA_EXPORTS.DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: Choose what to include. We’ll prepare your ZIP in the background; you can continue working while it’s being created.
DATA_EXPORTS.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Create an export to keep a copy of your contacts, conversations or knowledge library.
DATA_EXPORTS.ACTIVE: An export is already being prepared. You can create another when it finishes.
DATA_EXPORTS.DOWNLOAD_ERROR: We could not download this export. Refresh the list and try again.

CONTENTS.all: Contacts, conversations with private notes and attachments, and your knowledge library.
CONTENTS.contacts: A contact spreadsheet with names, email addresses, phone numbers and custom fields.
CONTENTS.conversations: Conversation and message spreadsheets, readable transcripts, private notes and original attachments.
CONTENTS.knowledge: Articles, documents and FAQs as spreadsheets, plus original documents and native knowledge archives.
